description: Web search on the Desearch index (POST /search). Returns ranked pages, each with its title, URL, publication date when known, and the passage that best matches the query. Set summary: true for a short answer written from the results with numbered citations; [n] in summary.text refers to summary.citations[].index. Set page_text to add each page's full text. Returns { summary, results, meta, cost_usd, usage_count, service, currency }, with summary first when requested; summary is null and meta.notices says 'Summary unavailable.' when it could not be written. Use search for titles and links only, and web-search for SERP-style snippets.

end_date.description: Only pages published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

exclude_domains.description: Never pages on these domains or their subdomains (at most 1,200). Wins over include_domains and site:.

highlights.description: Include the passage that best matches the query (API default true).

include_domains.description: Only pages on these domains or their subdomains (at most 100), example: ['bbc.com', 'reuters.com']

mode.description: 'fast' returns results sooner; 'balanced' (API default) favors relevance.

page_text.description: Include each page's full text (API default false).

query.description: Search query, example: 'Who won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics?'

start_date.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

summary.description: Also return a short answer written from the results, with numbered citations (API default false). No extra charge.

name: search-api
title: Search API
